reviews.title: I don't recommend
reviews.text: My partner and I choose this company for the first time. The landing time in Delhi was early morning - around 9:30 am; perfect for us because we could come back with enough time to reach our work in the afternoon. But it turned out to be challenging when 2 days before my trip started, the company changed the time of the flight affecting the landing time to 11h10 am. Things started to be bad when we tried to reach out to the company through phone calls, e-mails, and even the company site chat box... but everything showed up to be useless. When it was time to travel, the company still delayed 1 hour... It was a very bad experience. Not only because I and my partner couldn't reach in the time predicted by the company, but also because the company crew didn't know much about what was going on and couldn't give us information, not even the proper gate number that was the in the printed ticket happened. It was a different gate that we also figured out moments about to board. The only thing good about this flight was the food served on the airplane.

reviews.title: Worst flying experience ever, an unsafe and unpleasant flight journey
reviews.text: I booked flight from KUL to Kathmandu through Nepal airlines. Although I was warned by couple of my friends to not travel with Nepal airlines but I thought to give it a try and here is my experience. My flight was about to depart at 6:10 AM on 15/12/2022 from KUL(RA 416) and as it was early morning flight we reached airport early by 1 AM, Nepal airlines ground staff told me to wait till 1:40 AM to start the checkin process, which is fine and we happily waited till 1:40 AM, and the magic starts, we were not allowed the checkin till 5 AM in morning. After checking couple of times, it was told that flight got delayed due to bad weather but their staff was not aware on what will be the estimated time of departure. Mystery goes on and we get to know at 6 AM that flight is delayed by 10 hours, which was shocking and frustrating. We had further bookings for further travel from Kathmandu and hotel bookings and tried explaining this to staff. Their staff was rude and mentioned that this is your personal arrangements, we cannot do anything. Another concern was that Nepal airlines did not share its data with any flight tracking system so we never know what's happening and not able to track. Flight tracking systems still shows that flight landed on time which is quite funny. It was a furstrating experience and I am still waiting at the airport so that I can reach safely to Kathmandu, even my further arrangements does not make any sense. Please think twice before booking with Nepal airlines. I did not believe on friend's suggestions but later became a victim of their unprofessional operations. Regards, Ankit

reviews.title: Can't buy, can't fly, can't refund - avoid if you can!
reviews.text: Worst experience in 25 years - and we did not even fly yet! Airline from 1980s - almost impossible to buy ticket online. Nobody respond for emails. Dozens of individual phone numbers where nobody pick up the line. Online ticket purchase was not working for 2 weeks. I wrote emails to ALL addresses I found - got reply from UAE office that we can buy ticket for cash in their office and got response from Japanese office, that I should buy ticket online, after they fix online sales. No other responses at all. Nothing, complete silence. Ok, they fixed online sales after two weeks - I spent several hours trying to buy ticket, while facing all possible issues: session timeout, reservation expired, transaction failed, etc... Two weeks after I got information that outbound flight is cancelled, with invitation to contact them by email. No options for rebooking or refund. Guess what? not a single response by email, no matter what address I send email... Calling to land line? Try all numbers you can find - probably 1 out of 10 would pick up the phone, but they can't even catch your booking number. "Sierra is for C, right? sorry, I do not understand. A, B, C - yes?" it is 14:00 in Nepal and there is one single person in the office, "nobody is here"? Seriously? You want refund? Call to financial department, use numbers where nobody answer... I can't believe this business still exist in 2022...

reviews.title: Nepal Airlines has monstrous staffs at check-in desk.
reviews.text: As it was short Kathmandu Delhi flight I had no complains about the flight or what goes in the cabins. I however deplore the monstrous Nepal Airlines staffs at the check-in desk. These people, so unfriendly and uninformed yet act like the boss of entire universe. It so pathetic and ridiculous, at the same time. In my case, I had to go to Delhi to take language exam, and I had to take my breastfeeding baby. Due to horrendous patriarchal practice at the local government, my baby doesn’t yet have birth registration certificate (without father's presence, apparently, the local 'new dictator kings' don’t allow it!). So, before heading to the airport I called and asked if I can take my baby with me with hospital and vaccination documents, and the same was asked at Delhi airport; in both locations, I was told it is possible, no need for birth registration certificate. But when I reached Nepal Airlines desk, I was treated like an either a fool or flight risk. That is, they refused to check-in my child. It was a total shock, but I still wanted to know why they said I can go then and now I cannot! Instead of answer, I was told if I want to take my child, I must get a special letter from CDO (chief district officer) in this last hour, that too, at 6 am. They were so rude. I even requested to talk to an immigration officer, but 3 of the Nepal Airlines staffs pushed me aside. I had my exam the next day, and in Nepal, even if I were to beg with CDO, nothing gets done (at least not on time) so I had no choice. I tried every possible way but Nepal Airlines staffs were adamant on letting me suffer. At last, I was forced to abruptly leave my baby behind (well someone had to take away, by then, it was just a few minutes before I could board); when I went into the plane in tears, everyone was asking what I did with my baby (as if I was a cruel mother!). The whole journey was horrendous, which of course had a negative impact on my exam the next day. In short, Nepal Airlines staffs are arrogant and inhumane; it seems they thrive while innocent passengers suffer. This is so sad and sickening. This should never happen anyone, and the next day I wrote my entire ordeal to Nepal Airlines head office, no one has even bothered to send me an acknowledgement. This would never happen with any other airlines. It also shows how dysfunctional and corrupt Nepal airlines is...

reviews.title: First time on Nepal Airlines
reviews.text: Nepal Airline has a very bad reputation about delays etc. So i never flew with them. But this time i thought i will give a try for once just to see how it is. As this is my first ever on Nepal airline. I am a Nepalese British. As a follower of Pilot Vijay Lama. I thought i will try this time to support our country. Usually i always fly with QatarAirways and i am a frequent flyer with them. The main reason to write this review is that i am very disappointed with the service i got from the air hostess. The plane itself is good. I am talking about only the service. As usual the flight got delay as the actual flight was in the morning but delayed till afternoon. As i boarded the plane i was very very thirsty and started to cough too. As the the moment the situation of the covid19 . Everyone is very alert about it so when i cough the other passengers might not feel comfortable so i requested for a water as soon as i got in the plane. As i don't want to be a trouble to all the air hostess i tried to ask for the water to the same air hostess very politely. As i can understand her situation. She said wait a minute but the wait a minute turned into nearly a hour until they started serving the food. Even during that time. The air hostess completely ignored me and my request for a damn WATER. When she came near my seat I had to ask her again for the damn WATER. I am shocked by the service of the airline. On top of that the FOOD was terrible. I didn't even touch it. That ok. No wonder whey the reputation of the airline is so bad because of some of the behaviour of the air hostesses. I got the name of that airhostess is Ms. Shah. HORRIBLE lady. No Smile nothing Looks very angry too. Need to be re-trained on customer services. If the airline want to improve the image i suggest you to first train the Air hostess to how to serve the passengers. We as a passenger rate the airline mostly by the service you get. Qatar Airways reviews comes on top as their service is top notch. You should learn from them i guess. UNHAPPY PASSENGER never will recommend to any one. Just for Vijay dai i tried but never again. Sorry
